title: Lab-Grown Diamond Prices Fell From $4,200 To $380
hook: A lab-grown diamond fell to $380 wholesale.
closing: The collapse matters because manufactured scarcity no longer supports the old premium.
question: Would the price change your choice?

segments.say: A lab-grown diamond fell to $380 wholesale. The old luxury price collapsed.
The lab-grown price shown is $380. Its natural comparison remains far higher.
Lab-grown stones reached 47% of engagement-ring sales. Buyers increasingly chose the cheaper option.
